sentences.text: Dawn of the Dead -LRB- also known internationally as Zombi -RRB- is a 1978 American independent zombie horror film directed by George A. Romero .	George A. Romero	George A. Romero	independent	independent film	zombie	Zombie films	horror film	horror film

It was written by Romero in collaboration with the Italian filmmaker Dario Argento , and produced by Claudio Argento , Richard P. Rubinstein and Alfredo Cuomo .	Richard P. Rubinstein	Richard P. Rubinstein	Claudio Argento	Claudio Argento	Dario Argento	Dario Argento

It was the second film made in Romero 's Living Dead series , but contains no characters or settings from Night of the Living Dead , and shows in a larger scale the apocalyptic effects on society .	Night of the Living Dead	Night of the Living Dead	apocalyptic effects on society	Zombie apocalypse
In the film , a phenomenon of unidentified origin has caused the reanimation of the dead , who prey on human flesh , which subsequently causes mass hysteria .	reanimation of the dead	undead

The cast features David Emge , Ken Foree , Scott Reiniger , and Gaylen Ross as survivors of the outbreak who barricade themselves inside a suburban shopping mall .	David Emge	David Emge	Ken Foree	Ken Foree	Scott Reiniger	Scott Reiniger	Gaylen Ross	Gaylen Ross	shopping mall	shopping mall

Dawn of the Dead was filmed over approximately four months , from late 1977 to early 1978 , in the Pennsylvania cities of Pittsburgh and Monroeville .	Pennsylvania	Pennsylvania	Pittsburgh	Pittsburgh	Monroeville	Monroeville, Pennsylvania
Its primary filming location was the Monroeville Mall .	Monroeville	Monroeville, Pennsylvania	Monroeville Mall	Monroeville Mall
The film was made on a budget estimated at $ 1.5 million and was a significant box office success for its time , grossing approximately $ 55 million worldwide .
Since opening in theaters in 1978 , and despite heavy gore content , reviews for the film have been positive .

In addition to four official sequels , the film has spawned numerous parodies and pop culture references .	official	Canon (fiction)	parodies and pop culture references	Dawn of the Dead in popular culture
A remake of the movie premiered in the United States on March 19 , 2004 .	remake of the movie	Dawn of the Dead (2004 film)
It was labeled a `` re-imagining '' of the original film 's concept .	re-imagining	Remake

In 2008 , Dawn of the Dead was chosen by Empire magazine as one of The 500 Greatest Movies of All Time , along with Night of the Living Dead .	Night of the Living Dead	Night of the Living Dead	Empire	Empire (magazine)
